products.name: Colossyan
products.note: AI video avatars; enterprise training; consent management; UK-hosted

reading.body:
Colossyan converts training documents into AI-generated video courses using hundreds of synthetic avatars and voiceovers, hosted in the UK for enterprise customers.

The platform reduces the labor cost of producing training content by automating video generation from existing materials. This is a narrow application of generative video: the user provides source material and editorial control, and the system fills in execution. The company positions itself as enterprise-focused rather than consumer-facing, which shapes both its feature set and its hosting choice.

For AI infrastructure, Colossyan is a consumer of compute that runs on someone else's servers. It does not tell us where that compute runs, how much of it the company uses, or whether it faces constraints in scaling to more customers. The UK hosting note indicates a data residency decision, not power or building capacity.

The data does not cover funding, team size, customer count, revenue, or growth trajectory. It does not show whether Colossyan is compute-bound, and therefore does not reveal where the actual constraint on its expansion lies.

profile_text.body:
Colossyan is an AI video platform whose site describes Colossyan Creator as an AI video generator that uses real actors and can produce AI videos in under five minutes. The company says its AI agents draft a video or a full course from documents, decks, or a prompt, with the user editing and approving every scene. It positions the product for training employees, partners, and customers, and describes itself as a full platform rather than a video-only tool, covering video creation, course structure, interactivity, localization, and delivery in one workflow.

According to the site, the platform includes more than 300 AI avatars and voiceovers, video and course creation from PDFs and presentations, interactive elements such as branching scenarios and quizzes, localization into more than 100 languages, team collaboration, versioning without re-recording, and SCORM export for LMS delivery. Colossyan also offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required. The site quotes customers saying the technology improved new hire training productivity and that translation capabilities changed their training processes in a multi-lingual environment.

The site's own record lists Colossyan in the video generation and editing category, noting AI video avatars, enterprise training, consent management, and UK hosting. No litigation or MCP server entries are recorded for the company.
